violations.description: Test workflow missing explicit permissions block
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/test.yml has no top-level permissions or job-level permissions block defined.
violations.recommendation: Add an explicit permissions block (e.g. contents: read) to .github/workflows/test.yml following GitHub Actions security best practices.

violations.description: Fragile dist file sorting/indexing in nox tests session
violations.evidence: noxfile.py uses os.listdir("dist/") and takes generated_files[1] without sorting or checking file extension, assuming sdist vs wheel order.
violations.recommendation: Filter and explicitly select the sdist file (ending in .tar.gz) from dist/ rather than relying on unstable list order or arbitrary indexing.
